description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We are hiring a  Software Engineer for Distributed Systems Testing  with a passion for building and validating resilient distributed systems. You drive the success of those leveraging Canonical’s Ubuntu and Juju to build multi-cloud deployable applications. We see quality engineering as a first class engineering practice and are looking for people who can bring deep engineering insights and a data driven approach to testing, test automation, reporting and data analytics. The Distributed Systems testing team at Canonical is responsible for the high quality of Canonical’s Cloud solutions based on for example Juju, Terraform, OpenStack, or Kubernetes. Systems are tested and deployed under highly diverse conditions, from bare metal in customer data centers to public clouds such as AWS, GCE, Azure. As a software engineer you will have the opportunity to develop CI pipelines which power Canonical’s cloud integration testing and reporting. You will help test our products on new clouds and advance our AI/ML pipelines for automatic analysis of test results. A successful candidate is interested in tackling these problems, as well as imagining and leading new initiatives within the team and across Canonical. The role entails 
 Creating automated testing approaches and infrastructure for validating reliability, performance, and resilience of cloud orchestration tools and applications  
 Enabling engineering teams across Canonical to develop software with confidence by making distributed system testing tooling available across the company 
 Enhancing continuous integration pipelines for deploying and testing Canonical’s cloud native products such as Kubeflow 
 Deploying, managing, and debugging highly distributed systems on clouds and bare metal 
 Monitoring and reporting on automated testing efforts 
 Collaborating daily with a globally distributed team 
 What we are looking for in you 
 Solid background in modern test processes and strategies 
 Experience with Python or Go development 
 Strong object oriented development skills 
 Working knowledge of continuous integration tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub Actions 
 Knowledge of networking technologies and fundamentals 
 Solid understanding of the Linux system architecture 
 Complex abstract thinking 
 2-4 weeks of international travel travel per year 
 Nice-to-have skills 
 Ability to develop and ship modern production grade web applications 
 Ability to operate data platforms: key-value stores, relational or document databases, event buses 
 Data collection and analytics skills for large multidimensional datasets 
 Experience with AI/ML pipelines 
 Experience with cloud technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS 
 What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

About Us: 
 Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come. 
 About the Role: 
 We’re hiring a Full-Stack Growth Engineer to build and maintain the product and systems that help more of the right people discover Future, convert into members, and reach their first moments of value. 
 You’ll work across web and backend surfaces that power acquisition, signup and access, onboarding and activation, and early engagement. You’ll ship experiments end to end, instrument funnels carefully, and partner closely with product, design, data, and marketing on a small, senior team. 
 This is a hands-on role. You’ll move between product judgment and system design, write production code, run trustworthy experiments, and turn learnings into durable product improvements — not one-off hacks. 
 What You’ll Own: 
 
 Acquisition and Conversion:  Build and improve the web and product surfaces that introduce Future to prospective members and turn interest into signup. These include landing experiences, checkout and plan selection flows, and the instrumentation that shows where people drop off. 
 Access and Onboarding:  Simplify signup, login, account creation, and first-session activation. Remove friction, clarify value on Day 1, and help new members connect with coaching and get started quickly. 
 Experimentation Systems:  Design, ship, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across the funnel. Partner with data to define metrics, guardrails, and experiment hygiene so we learn fast without polluting the product. 
 Full-Stack Delivery : Implement features across frontend and backend — APIs, services, web UI, and the glue between growth surfaces and the core member product. Prefer clear ownership and fast iteration over brittle one-off paths. 
 Measurement and Insight:  Instrument funnels, cohorts, and activation milestones. Use qualitative and quantitative signal to find leverage, prioritize work, and explain why experiments won or lost. 
 Reliability for Growth Paths:  Keep high-traffic growth journeys fast, stable, and observable. Treat conversion-critical paths with the same engineering care as core product. 
 Cross-Functional Partnership:  Work tightly with product, design, data, and marketing. Translate growth hypotheses into shippable product work and bring engineering judgment into roadmap tradeoffs. 
 AI-Assisted Development:  Use coding agents and AI tools to speed up exploration, implementation, testing, and review. Apply engineering judgment to validate their output before it reaches members or prospects. 
 
 Who You Are: 
 Experience and Background 
 
 You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer growth, acquisition, activation, or conversion surfaces. 
 You are strong full-stack: comfortable across modern web frontend and backend services, and able to ship an experiment from UI through API and data without waiting on another team for every layer. 
 You have run growth experiments in production — A/B tests, funnel instrumentation, and iteration based on measured outcomes, not vibes alone. 
 You understand customer journeys: segments, touchpoints, dropoff analysis, and how product changes move activation and retention metrics. 
 You can debug across web UI, networking, backend services, analytics pipelines, and CI. 
 You have partnered with product, design, and data (or marketing) to take ambiguous growth problems from hypothesis to shipped learning.
